title: Regular local ring, regular ring, regular scheme
statement: A *regular local ring* is a Noetherian local ring $(R,\mathfrak m)$ whose maximal ideal can be generated by $\dim R$ elements, $\dim R$ the Krull dimension. A Noetherian ring $R$ is *regular* if every localization $R_{\mathfrak p}$ at a prime ideal is a regular local ring. A scheme $X$ [def-pc-scheme] is *regular* if every point has an affine open neighbourhood $U$ with $\mathcal O_X(U)$ Noetherian and regular; equivalently (Stacks Lemma 02IT), $X$ is locally Noetherian and every local ring $\mathcal O_{X,x}$ is a regular local ring.
